messages:
samir: heads-up — after last night's allocator sweep i see repeated cross-rack handoffs for tenant 'alpha-ops' in eu-west rack-18. p95 for gen-api jumped ~120ms. anyone watching the fleet?
taylor: confirming. saw ~220 redispatch events in 30m from rack-18 -> rack-7. kvcache miss goes up each time.
zhou: net counters on tor12 show rx_crc_errors and some RX drops coinciding with the window. weirdly coincides with a vendor switch firmware push at 02:40 UTC.
maya: could be a short mtud bounce or offload renegotiation. flips like that blow TCP path MTU and cause retransmits -> higher CPU/latency.
samir: what are our quick mitigations? micro-carveout for 'alpha-ops' probably stabilizes but costs money.
taylor: alternatives: 1) scheduler hysteresis delay (hold redispatch for 45s to let kvcache warm) 2) prefer-same-rack for noisy cohorts 3) carve micro-silo of 2 gpus reserved for alpha-ops.
ops-bot: alert: redispatch_spike detected for cohort=alpha-ops at 02:58 UTC, count=224
zhou: i'm leaning to hysteresis + network triage. if the switch FW flipped, carving won't fix the underlying packet loss. we should get netops involved and capture pcap during mitigation.
maya: agree. small canary: enable hysteresis=45s for cohort alpha-ops at 1% traffic, capture metrics for 20m. command: `infractl scheduler set hysteresis --cohort alpha-ops --duration 45s --rate 0.01`
samir: cost check if we do carve: 2 gpus reserved * $0.72/hr * 24 * 30 ~= $1036/mo. add buffer for 4 gpus ~= $2072/mo.
taylor: SLA hit math: every 1% p99 increase maps to ~ $150/mo hit for a high-SLA customer; last 7 days avg uplift ~3% for alpha-ops during spikes -> ~$450/mo. so carve might pay for itself if persistent.
zhou: netops @netops please confirm whether the vendor fw completed and whether MTU/ECN toggles were applied on tor12 at 02:40. file ticket NET-7238.
aylor: starting canary now. ops-bot will report metrics.
aylor: canary results after 25m: redispatch rate down ~58%, kvcache hit +9pts, p95 dropped ~40ms. latency stable at 10% rollout.
maya: tor12 still shows intermittent CRCs but lower rate. netops says they rolled back a partial config change around 03:05 and will do deeper capture.
samir: based on canary, path A (hysteresis + rebalancer tweak) seems promising. path B (micro-carve) is fallback. please run a short A/B cost simulation for both.
zhou: i'll open infra bug INF-9987 to adjust rebalancer to prefer warm buckets and add a cache-warm stall. include telemetry hooks.
aylor: action items: taylor -> continue 10% ramp and long traces; zhou -> NET-7238 followup + pcap; maya -> validate hysteresis rollout safety; samir -> cost memo for carve vs fix.
samir: thanks. let's not rush into carving until netops confirms switch health. we'll choose carve only if errors persist after rebalancer change. :thumbsup:
